policies.title: Guatemalan ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked schedule requires Guatemalan visitors to obtain a visa before arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Guatemalan passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a mission or consulate before travel.
The active schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if replaced.
Work, study, residence, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Guatemalan ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Guatemalan visitors can obtain a visa on arrival for 40 JOD.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Guatemalan passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Guatemala's outbound visa page is expressly guide-only and defers to destination authorities; the current destination table controls.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Guatemalan ordinary passports: Panama visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule lists Guatemala in its No Visa Required cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Guatemalan passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to three months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.
